title: Claude trading
author: Distinct_Bet_6629
selftext:
What are some prompts to help Claude find and analyze stocks better?   
I’m saying like find a strong stock and analyze it like a “Wall Street analyst/investor”. 

I’ve gotten to the point where I can type in a stock for it to run through **ALPHA VANTAGE** and it gives me some basic info, basically just saves time. 

Any ideas. 

Even if you have some stocks you are currently watching. Feel free to share.

comments.author: Tight_Papaya_2164
comments.body: You should download all the data you absolutely can all the way back past 20 years freeze your data to a parquet since fetching data at different times can corrupt ur parquet so focus on downloading all the data you can then you sit and go through everything

comments.author: Routine_Bat6675
comments.body: I am using stock analysis API to automate my trades can recommend [Sentimentick](https://www.sentimentick.com)

comments.author: RNAlgotrading
comments.body: Claude is not an investment Advisor. It reads from the available data and give you an informed decision. It can still go wrong. But certainly it saves time, But you still need to spend some time in understanding the output.

replies.author: Distinct_Bet_6629
replies.body: How can I get that information to Claude like automatically? I type in the ticker and all that information is pulled and used to make a good decision about a stock.

replies.author: RNAlgotrading
replies.body: Claude doesn't provide that information directly, But you can create a small APP or software using Claude, that can get you most of the fundamental data that you are looking for.

replies.author: Distinct_Bet_6629
replies.body: Like alpha vantage? I want to improve this because I use this now

replies.author: Pigafetta1522
replies.body:
I am doing a lot of Stock analysis with LLMs and I am using two approaches, the one that gives the highest“accuracy“ although that is impossible to measure is giving Claude Opus 4.8 MAX, Fable 5 high and Opus 5 xhigh all the same prompt, they search by themselves for sources and they all build a DCF for me, by giving them the task of building a DCF model they pull accurate financial data, next I have a session that compares the 3 and it writes a report on how they differ. This report is given to the Opus 4.8MAX session as feedback and then I use that session for further discussion and analysis. As you can imagine this is relatively expensive and eats trough the 20x MAX plan. 

The second approach I am working on is a harness that feeds a local LLM all the financial data and news etc for a stock and gives it different tools to value a stock, one run takes 8min and it currently has 70% accuracy compared to Opus 4.8 MAX analysis so this is still a work in progress.

comments.author: Bergodrake
comments.body: Would be interesting to give him a platform like Trigol.io with data and signals everyday

comments.author: Training-Welder6866
comments.body: If you want to pull in analysis (usually from the top newsletters like burry, SemiAnalysis, lyn alden, etc.), you should add the [dripstack.com](http://dripstack.com) MCP to claude. This will give you analyst opinions in addition to the raw data you get from alpha vantage.
